name: Afterflow
description: a predictive input cheat that fixes your early clicks and makes them accurate.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: allow the terminal key to open the afterflow log window

wave-margin.name: wave safety margin
wave-margin.description: adds 1 extra tick of delay in wave when there is room. safer but can feel late. off = earliest safe click

show-feedback.name: show feedback
show-feedback.description: shows a small text at the top of the level when afterflow fixes a click (green) or cant save it (red)

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for afterflow

keybind-terminal.name: terminal
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the afterflow terminal
